note: Records with no picture we may use, listed by hand with the reason. scripts/check_image_health.mjs reports them but does not fail for them; it says when one has a working picture again or is gone, and then the entry comes off. Before adding one, look for an allowed source (data/manual-images.json).

reasons.godo_mall: Pokémon Store Korea lists only pictures on pokemon.hgodo.com, its closed Godo mall (no answer, not even robots.txt, on 2026-11-16; the shop's own page shows them broken). No other allowed source shows the product (checked 2026-11-16).
reasons.pokemon_center_hotlink: Pokémon Store Korea's only pictures are linked from www.pokemoncenter-online.com, which refuses hotlinks and answered our bot with 403 (2026-11-15); no catalog record has the same JAN. cache:pokemon-center-images copies it on a day the host lets the bot through.
